newsitem.title: GREECE: STRINTZIS LINES DEPLOYS IONIAN BRIDGE FERRY.
newsitem.headline: STRINTZIS LINES DEPLOYS IONIAN BRIDGE FERRY.

text.p: Passenger shipper Strintzis Lines said its Ionian Bridge ferry will start servicing the Igoumenitsa-Brindisi sea route on Saturday June 28 bringing the company's routes to Italy to 20 weekly.
Ionian Bridge was purchased in January 1997 and revamped in Greece in compliance with recent SOLAS and IMO safety standards at a cost of $16 million, Strintzis Lines said.
The vessel can carry 800 passengers and 650 cars and makes the route in 7.5 hours connecting Greece with Italy daily. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
